_comment: Starter CAPVisualizer assertion pack. Declarative expectations evaluated offline against an export by CapTest.psm1 / Invoke-CapTest.ps1. Independent DSL (not Pester). Assertion types: compliance (a baseline control result), findingThreshold (no findings at/above a severity), whatif (a simulated sign-in outcome). Tune the whatif principalId/resource values to your tenant.
name: CAPVisualizer starter assertions

assertions.name: Phishing-resistant MFA must be enforced for privileged roles (MS.AAD.3.6)
MFA must be required for all users (MS.AAD.3.2)
There must be no critical-severity findings
